photos.description: 2025-05-01: approaching from Nanjing East Road. Six rectangular lights in each of two horizontal bands on the nearest passage. Narrow colonnette-like strips separate the ochre masonry bays, a thin projecting cap shadows the top, and the dark soffit is suspended above traffic. The second bridge is partly visible behind and is excluded.
photos.author: Suicasmo

photos.description: The upper section is partly cropped. Night light shows paired panes and narrow dark frames inside the openings, a projecting roof edge, and a flat soffit.
photos.author: Chainwit.

photos.description: 2011 oblique view shows the near passage with darker material in shade, two window bands and no central street support. The lower corners are partly obscured.
photos.author: Legolas1024

primary_reference_page_retrieval.read: Photographer Suicasmo, own work, May 1, 2025 and CC0 1.0 confirmed from this Commons file page.

identity.observed: New building is 627 Nanjing East Road with two enclosed passages linking the older building to its west. The new block lies between Nanjing East Road, Zhejiang Middle Road, Jiujiang Road and Hubei Road.

placement_basis: North passage over Zhejiang Middle Road. Approximate wall-line distances and anchors sampled from the separately authored neighboring GLBs. No evidence of bridge supports in the lane. No identified independent source owner.
geometry_scope: Only the northern, two-level bridge facing Nanjing East Road. Front bay count and the division between glazing/spandrels come from the 2025 view. Back elevation repeats approximate bay divisions; flat roof, soffit, wall insertions, width and absolute elevations are estimates. No complete structural or access survey.
